name: Kilnwatch Bastion
core_rationale: Fortified terracotta potter-garrison perched on the western lip of Kilnfire Terraces where glaze-artisans maintain the aqueduct sluices from Kiln East Orchard and guard the approach to the Kettle-Whistle Viaduct.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Steaming glaze-cooling cisterns flanking the central kiln plaza

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors district-kilnfire-terraces at [0, 1] and links West to hunting-area-kiln-east-orchard in Teacup Meadows.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Glazed terracotta bastion towers and steaming porcelain cistern plazas built for 1.05m Sprout artisans.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Grass <= 0.24m, bushes <= 0.52m, terrace steps <= 0.16m, and 14.0m main highway for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Peaceful garrison safe zone with zero hostile spawns and symmetric West/East portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Complete playable garrison town node with zero placeholder boilerplate.
